summary: Redwood Trust filed an 8-K on September 10, 2026, disclosing preliminary agreements to dispose of certain legacy bridge loans with aggregate unpaid principal balance of up to roughly $190 million, plus a routine Q3 common dividend of $0.18 per share. The company targets closing late Q3 or early Q4 2026. The board declared dividends; no advisor was named. The expected impact is an approximately 2% decrease in book value per share from the June 30, 2026 level. Watch definitive documentation execution, final proceeds versus principal, and any further book-value dilution risk.
